draft.emotion: firm and energetic, standing solid and sure of oneself
notes: Has the same form for masculine and feminine ('fuerte', plural 'fuertes'). Also commonly used as an adverb meaning 'hard' or 'loudly' ('Habla más fuerte' — Speak louder; 'Llueve fuerte' — It's raining hard).

senses.definition: Having great physical power, or able to resist force or weight without breaking.
